profile.headline: Cramming non-browser things into the browser
profile.summary: Standard computer nerd, I love programming and solving problems. Professionally, most of my experience is in the Scala/TypeScript/MySQL stack. I stay on the bleeding edge of web tech, experimenting with low-level browser APIs like WebAssembly, WebRTC, and WebGL. I strongly believe that the web is a powerful platform that in many cases is being under-utilized, especially in online gaming. I love graphics programming as well - C++, OpenGL, Vulkan, DirectX 11, WebGL, and enjoy tinkering around from small side projects, to open source contributions, to public demos.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Work with small team to identify, develop, test and deploy improvements to cloud based software, providing a high quality experience to our users. Responsibilities include writing client facing code as well as back end server code.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description: Work with students in the Computer Science program at Utah State to help them better understand topics in CS classes, and provide feedback to professors and other faculty to help the Computer Science department to continually improve.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Gather requirements from customer requests
- Determine software architecture for best results
- Design, develop, document, and test your applications
- Implement continual software improvement
